save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer, scheduler, and config to a directory
load_model_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint and restore optimizer, scheduler, and training state
create_warmup_linear_scheduler: create a WarmupLinearScheduler learning rate scheduler with warmup steps and linear decay
create_cosine_scheduler: create a CosineScheduler learning rate scheduler with warmup steps and cosine annealing
track_weighted_average_stats: track and compute weighted average statistics across distributed processes using WeightedAvgStats
